map.📚 深度解析：冷却系统三项检测判定（冷却/老化保持/成分）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Cooling-System Test (Cooling / Aging Retention / Composition)
map.冷却系统维护自检：按冷却效率、老化后性能保持率、成分合格率三项判定: Cooling-system maintenance self-check: judge by three items — cooling efficiency, post-aging performance retention, composition pass rate
map.换热保障：冷却效率直接关系散热能力: Heat-transfer assurance: cooling efficiency directly relates to heat dissipation
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于维护验收: Report usability: all three must pass before maintenance acceptance
map.逐项判定：冷却效率≥85%、老化后性能保持率≥80%、成分合格率≥95%；三项均: Item-by-item: cooling efficiency ≥ 85%, post-aging performance retention ≥ 80%, composition pass rate ≥ 95%; all three satisfied = pass. Low efficiency or retention signals fouling/aging.
map.冷却效率 88%（≥85 ✓）、老化保持率 82%（≥80 ✓）、成分合格率 9: Cooling efficiency 88% (≥85 ✓), aging retention 82% (≥80 ✓), composition pass rate 96% (≥95 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If cooling efficiency drops to 80% it fails, insufficient heat dissipation.
map.常用进出水温差与流量算实际换热量对比理论值；效率偏低多因结垢、流量不足或介质劣化: Typically the actual heat exchange is computed from inlet/outlet water temperature difference and flow, compared with the theoretical value; low efficiency is mostly due to fouling, insufficient flow, or degraded medium — clean or replenish.
map.重要，反映冷却液/系统长期性能留存；保持率<80% 提示介质老化、防腐与换热能力: Yes, it reflects the long-term performance reserve of the coolant/system; retention <80% signals medium aging and declining anti-corrosion/heat-transfer capacity, so replace it.
